div.p: This value set includes codes based on the following rules:

ul.li: Import all the codes that are contained in Stroke Risk Factor ValueSet
Include all codes defined in http://qualityregistry.org/CodeSystem/stroke-risk-factor-cs version 📦0.1.0
Import all the codes that are contained in Absent or Unknown Problems - IPS

description.value: Defines standard and locally governed conditions or assertions relevant to stroke risk, including an option for unknown status.

purpose.value: To aggregate core stroke risk factors, locally governed RES-Q assertions, and unknown/absent problem concepts for comprehensive capture and validation.
